claims.claim: Codex and Antigravity native REPAIR instructions now explicitly distinguish CODE_FIX, NO_CHANGE, and CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION, permit bounded unfinished TASK discovery/live capture only for CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION, and preserve all lineage, scope, dispatch, and Runtime-owned verification boundaries.

Native adapter regressions exercise the real Codex prompt and Antigravity instruction/transport paths, proving CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION can produce a committed bounded delta while CODE_FIX and NO_CHANGE retain their established semantics.
The operator regression binds CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION to the exact failed RUN and selected Executor, invokes the native adapter once, then preserves the Runtime verification boundary.
Only the two authorized production adapters and three authorized test files were modified; implementation-local syntax compilation succeeded and canonical verification remains owned by Runtime.
